data.description: The Scrap Transport Helicopter, aka the scrappy or scrap heli, is the transport heli for moving a group around the map, with 2 seats and room for everyone else to stand in the back. A scrappy costs 1250 scrap at the [Airwolf Vendor](/world/airwolf-vendor) and comes with 100 low grade fuel. It burns 30 low grade a minute, so a full 500 tank gives about 16.7 minutes of flight. It holds up to 5 [flares](/items/flare), and shredding one yields 300 scrap.
